title: Anime Escadron
features:
Farm — Auto-claim all (quests, daily, bounties, battlepass, milestones, beginner missions); Auto-summon (x1/x10 with a gem reserve); Auto-sell pulls by rarity (Rare→Secret); Auto-equip-best.

Units — Stat reroll to a target stat + grade; Trait reroll to a target trait (shard reserve); Auto-sell inventory by rarity with keep-good filter; Auto-perks (yen/upgrades); Auto-craft.

Play — Pick world / act / difficulty; In-Stage box: Auto-Deploy Team, Auto-Play, Auto-Upgrade units, Auto Next Stage, Auto Replay, Auto Vote Start.

Misc — WalkSpeed, JumpPower, Infinite Jump, FOV, Anti-AFK; auto shop buying (merchant / raid); auto-bounty.

Settings — Show/hide modules (stats panel, watermark, keybinds); theme manager; save/load configs; Unload.

Every toggle and button also pops an on-screen notification when you use it. Play a wave and say "go" for the last proof.
